targets.created: one ChatSession plus one ChatMessage per copied row
targets.ledger: one AuditLog receipt in the same transaction

authority.route: mandatory get_current_user plus existing in-memory session ownership gate
authority.service: re-read current User; require active status; claim is_active/status/role/raw tenant inside the fork transaction
authority.source_owner: source ChatSession.user_id must equal the caller; foreign owner is refused with zero effect

routes.effect: authority claim + exact source-session claim + post-claim message-snapshot recheck + one new session, copied messages and one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: full/prefix fork verified; empty/unknown source legacy success=false; stale source/message 409; authority change 409; same-operation replay already_applied; rollback not_applied; readback committed_unverified; lost confirmation effect_unknown

receipt.sensitive_material: no raw message content, prompt, secret or SQL parameter
receipt.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target result digest must match

result_states.verified: legacy success shape plus additive verification/operation_id/audit_id
result_states.no_effect: empty/unknown source or missing boundary; legacy success=false; no audit
result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; no exception text

parallel_writers.in_memory_orchestrator: registers the verified fork id after commit; no SQL effect
